text: Can you put my face from this park selfie onto someone in this beach photo? I thought it would be a fun picture to have, but I’m a little worried the swap might look out of place. To explain which person I mean, it’s the blonde woman on the right in the pic of two friends, not the bearded man on the left, who should stay exactly as he is. Please use my face from the portrait selfie, and my hair can come with it so I’m recognisable, while keeping it looking like the original beach photo. The original wide 16:9 framing should stay, and free-tier size is fine. Basically, just swap that one face and leave everything else alone, with no text or other edits.
